korean: 예약을 깜빡했어요. 남은 자리는 프린터 옆뿐이었어요.

english: Back after three weeks at the fab
First day back in three weeks. Someone has been using your desk as a parcel shelf.
korean: 3주 만의 출근이에요. 누가 내 자리를 택배 선반으로 쓰고 있었어요.

english: What happens to your desk while away?
A desk that is always yours

korean: 다른 사람이 쓸 수 있는 자리

english: Your desk waits exactly as left
Empty for weeks at a time
My desk, my stuff. It should be here when I'm back.
korean: 내 자리, 내 물건이에요. 돌아왔을 때 그대로 있어야죠.

english: Your locked desk sat empty all month while the team hunted for seats.
korean: 팀이 자리를 찾아 헤매는 동안 잠긴 자리는 한 달 내내 비어 있었어요.

english: Fair to others, no place to land.
korean: 남에겐 공평, 나는 갈 곳 없음.

english: Desk helps others while you're away
No fixed spot to return to
Pack up before every fab trip
Thanks. We really needed that desk while you were gone.
korean: 고마워요. 없는 동안 그 자리가 정말 필요했거든요.

english: Back from the fab, you spent twenty minutes finding a free desk.
korean: 팹에서 돌아와 빈자리 찾는 데 20분이 걸렸어요.

english: Shared spots for returners near the team
Close to the team, never quite yours.
Land right next to your team
Any free spot, never the same
Good. Returners should sit with us, not in some far corner.
korean: 좋아요. 복귀자는 먼 구석 말고 우리 옆에 앉아야죠.

english: Three engineers came back at once. The landing zone was full.
korean: 엔지니어 세 명이 한꺼번에 복귀했어요. 복귀존이 꽉 찼어요.

english: New floor, new desk. You can have one upgrade.
korean: 새 사무실, 새 자리. 업그레이드는 하나만 고를 수 있어요.

english: Which one upgrade do you want?
Charts and code side by side
Two screens. Now I can see the tool logs and the report.
korean: 화면 두 개. 이제 장비 로그랑 보고서를 같이 볼 수 있어요.

english: Wider desks meant two fewer seats in your row.
korean: 책상이 넓어져서 같은 줄 좌석이 두 개 줄었어요.

english: Nice. Plug in anywhere and your screens just work.
korean: 좋네요. 어디서든 꽂기만 하면 화면이 바로 떠요.

english: Every desk works, but none of them feels like yours.
korean: 어느 자리든 되지만, 내 자리 같은 곳은 없어요.

english: Plenty of room, desk locked to you.
Finally, somewhere to keep my binders and spare cables.
korean: 드디어 바인더랑 여분 케이블 둘 데가 생겼어요.

english: Your desk can't join the sharing pool now. It sits empty on fab days.
korean: 이제 이 자리는 공유할 수 없어요. 팹 가는 날엔 비어 있어요.

english: New rule: clear your desk every night so cleaners and sharers can use it.
korean: 새 규칙이에요. 청소와 공유를 위해 매일 밤 책상을 비워 주세요.

english: Where do your things go tonight?
korean: 오늘 밤 내 물건은 어디에 둘까요?

english: Clean desks, queue at the lockers.
A walk to the locker daily
Your locker is the third on the left. Code is on your badge.
korean: 사물함은 왼쪽 세 번째예요. 비밀번호는 사원증에 있어요.

english: Locker bank by the lift was crowded at six. Everyone left at once.
korean: 6시에 엘리베이터 옆 사물함이 붐볐어요. 다들 동시에 퇴근했거든요.

english: A pedestal you roll each day
Mobile, but always pushing a cart.
Fine. I'll just park it by the window each night.
Caddies blocked the corridor overnight. I couldn't get the trolley through.
korean: 밤새 카트가 복도를 막아서 청소 카트가 못 지나갔어요.

english: Easy for you, unfair to others.
Desk stays how you like it

korean: 청소할 때 내 물건 피해 가기

english: Okay, but then nobody else can use that desk.
korean: 알겠어요. 그럼 그 자리는 다른 사람이 못 써요.

english: Others are clearing up nightly. They're asking why your desk is different.
korean: 다들 매일 밤 정리하는데, 왜 당신 자리만 다르냐고 물어요.

english: Your own locker, two fewer desks.
A locked spot for every kit
A locker with my name on it. Finally, no more guessing.
korean: 내 이름 붙은 사물함이라니. 이제 헤맬 일 없겠네요.

english: Two people lost their desks, and the big sample box still sat on the floor.
korean: 두 명이 자리를 잃었는데, 큰 샘플 박스는 여전히 바닥에 있어요.

english: We lost an hour looking for the O-ring kit again.
korean: O-링 키트 찾느라 또 한 시간 날렸어요.

english: Caged parts room with a hatch
One place for every kit. No more hunting through drawers.
korean: 키트가 전부 한곳에. 이제 서랍 뒤질 일 없겠네요.

english: We lost the meeting room. Weekly reviews moved to the cafe.
korean: 회의실이 없어졌어요. 주간 리뷰는 카페로 옮겼어요.
상태 화면이 있는 앱 예약 사물함

english: Book in the app, tap your badge, the door pops open.
korean: 앱에서 예약하고 사원증을 대면 문이 열려요.

english: Urgent call from the fab. I had to book a locker first.
korean: 팹에서 급한 전화가 왔는데, 사물함부터 예약해야 했어요.

english: Each engineer keeps a full kit

korean: 늘 손 닿는 곳에, 추적은 안 돼요.

english: A full kit at your desk

korean: 내 키트가 늘 손 닿는 곳에

english: Parts duplicated and hard to track
My own kit. Nobody borrows it, nobody loses it.
korean: 내 키트예요. 빌려 가는 사람도, 잃어버리는 사람도 없죠.

english: Desks are crammed. Nobody knows which O-rings are expired.
korean: 자리가 꽉 찼어요. 어떤 O-링이 만료됐는지 아무도 몰라요.

english: Six sample boxes need a safe, static-free home until Friday.
korean: 샘플 박스 6개를 금요일까지 정전기 없이 안전하게 둬야 해요.

english: Where do the sample boxes go?
Anti-static cabinet in the team zone
Safe samples in the team zone
Good. Static-free and right next to the team. I can relax.
korean: 좋아요. 정전기 걱정 없고 팀 바로 옆이라 안심이에요.

english: The collab table is gone. We huddled standing at the cabinet.
korean: 협업 테이블이 없어져서 캐비닛 앞에 서서 모였어요.

english: They stay with me. Come down whenever you need them.
korean: 제가 갖고 있을게요. 필요할 때 언제든 내려오세요.

english: Three trips to the lab before lunch. Nearly missed a review.
korean: 점심 전에 랩을 세 번 다녀왔어요. 리뷰를 놓칠 뻔했어요.

english: I'll stack them by my monitor. It's only until Friday.
One box got knocked off your desk. We have to check it.
korean: 박스 하나가 책상에서 떨어졌어요. 확인해 봐야 해요.

english: Your parcel is at reception. It closes at 12.
Pick up any time with a code
Any time, until they fill up.
Parcels any time with a code
Your code comes by text. Grab it whenever you like.
korean: 코드는 문자로 가요. 편할 때 찾아가세요.

english: The lockers were full. My parcel went back to reception anyway.
korean: 보관함이 꽉 차서 결국 택배가 안내데스크로 돌아갔어요.

english: No trip, but a long wait.
We'll bring it up at four. Just make sure you're at your desk.
You weren't at your desk. Your parcel went back downstairs.
korean: 자리에 안 계셔서 택배를 다시 1층으로 가져갔어요.

english: Simple, but the noon queue stays.
I'll run down now. Hope the line isn't long.
korean: 지금 내려갈게요. 줄이 길지 않으면 좋겠네요.

english: Twelve people in line. Your lunch went cold on the desk.
korean: 줄이 열두 명이었어요. 점심은 책상 위에서 식었고요.

english: Wing-back chair that wraps around you
A quiet nook right on the floor
I tucked into the wing chair and kept my voice low.
korean: 윙 의자에 쏙 들어가서 목소리를 낮췄어요.

english: The next desk caught a customer's name. Your lead asked you to step out.
korean: 옆자리에서 고객 이름을 들었대요. 팀장님이 자리를 옮기라고 했어요.

english: Can we talk about something personal? Somewhere private.
korean: 개인적인 얘기 좀 할 수 있을까요? 조용한 데서요.

english: Where do you have the talk?
Private and close, one sofa gone.
This is good. Nobody can hear us in here.
The sofa is gone. Nowhere to sit for a quick chat now.
korean: 소파가 없어졌어요. 이제 잠깐 앉아 얘기할 데가 없어요.

english: A real room, no huddle table.
korean: 제대로 된 방, 허들 테이블은 없어요.

english: Thanks for finding a real room. This matters to me.
korean: 제대로 된 방을 찾아 줘서 고마워요. 저한텐 중요한 얘기라서요.

english: The huddle table is gone. Our stand-up now happens in the aisle.
korean: 허들 테이블이 없어져서 스탠드업을 통로에서 해요.

english: Easy and calm, until it rains.
A walk is nice. Easier to talk side by side.
korean: 산책 좋아요. 나란히 걸으면 얘기하기 편하죠.

english: It started raining halfway through. We cut it short.
Next year’s pricing. Confidential. Can you talk now?
korean: 내년 단가 건이에요. 기밀이에요. 지금 통화 돼요?

english: Windowless room with a badge reader
korean: 출입 카드 리더가 있는 창 없는 방

english: Good. Please confirm the room is secure before we start.
korean: 좋아요. 시작 전에 방이 안전한지 확인해 주세요.

english: One less meeting room. Our design review got bumped again.
korean: 회의실이 하나 줄어서 디자인 리뷰가 또 밀렸어요.

english: No room to share a deck
I'll grab the booth. Can you send the numbers by email?
korean: 부스로 갈게요. 수치는 메일로 보내 주실래요?

english: We couldn't walk through the deck together. Let's reschedule.
korean: 자료를 같이 못 봤네요. 일정 다시 잡죠.

english: Private, but out of the building.
Are you driving? It sounds like you're in a car park.
korean: 운전 중이세요? 주차장에 계신 것 같은데요.

english: You were in the car park when I needed you for sign-off.
How do you protect the charts?
Hard to share a quick look
Better. Now I have to lean in to show you anything, though.
korean: 낫네요. 대신 뭘 보여 주려면 몸을 기울여야 해요.

english: Quick screen checks got awkward. People email screenshots instead.
korean: 화면 잠깐 보는 게 어색해져서 다들 스크린숏을 메일로 보내요.

english: Good. Now we can put charts on the wall without worrying.
korean: 좋아요. 이제 걱정 없이 벽에 차트를 붙일 수 있어요.

english: I used to drop by with questions. Now I need a badge.
korean: 예전엔 질문하러 들르곤 했는데, 이젠 출입 카드가 필요해요.

english: Fine. I'll just minimise windows when someone walks by.
Someone saw the customer yield chart again. Now it's an issue.
korean: 누가 고객 수율 차트를 또 봤어요. 이제 문제가 됐어요.

english: Weekly call with California at 9 pm Korea time.
korean: 한국 시간 밤 9시, 캘리포니아와 주간 통화예요.

english: Where do you take the late call?
Home for dinner, shaky at home.
I'll head home and dial in after dinner.
Your audio kept cutting out. Can we redo the chart review?
korean: 소리가 계속 끊겼어요. 차트 리뷰 다시 할 수 있을까요?

english: Stay and use a proper room
A proper room for the call
Good call. The room looks much better than a laptop camera.
korean: 잘 정했어요. 노트북 카메라보다 훨씬 낫네요.

english: Call ended at ten. You got home past eleven, tired.
A pod you can use any hour

korean: 언제든 쓰는 부스, 라운지 한 구석과 맞바꿈.

english: A pod you can use anytime
Nice. You can jump on and be out the door in minutes.
korean: 좋네요. 접속했다가 몇 분 만에 퇴근할 수 있어요.

english: The lounge corner is gone. Afternoon coffee chats moved to the aisle.
korean: 라운지 구석이 없어져서 오후 커피 수다는 통로로 옮겼어요.

english: Paired desks with tall acoustic sides
korean: 높은 흡음 패널을 두른 짝 책상

english: Two quiet hours at your desk
Head down behind the panels. I can finally think.
korean: 패널 뒤에 숨어 집중. 드디어 생각이 되네요.

english: The analysis got done, but the team says the row now feels like cubicles.
korean: 분석은 끝냈지만, 팀은 이 줄이 칸막이 사무실 같대요.

english: Five service reports are overdue. Today would be good.
korean: 서비스 리포트 5건이 밀렸어요. 오늘 끝내면 좋겠어요.

english: Where do you write the reports?
Quiet desks, nowhere to sit back.
Good call. I've got two reports overdue as well.
korean: 잘 정했어요. 저도 밀린 리포트가 두 건이에요.

english: The sofa went. Visitors now wait standing by the lifts.
korean: 소파가 없어져서 방문객이 엘리베이터 앞에 서서 기다려요.

english: Room for one at a time
Someone else may be in it
Nice. A little cocoon, right here on the floor.
korean: 좋네요. 사무실 안의 작은 고치 같아요.

english: Two of you needed the pod. You waited forty minutes for it.
A day away from the team
Reports done, the team missed you.
Fine. Just keep your phone on for the fab.
korean: 좋아요. 팹 연락 오니까 전화는 켜 두세요.

english: Tomorrow's install moved up. They wanted you there in person.
korean: 내일 설치가 앞당겨졌어요. 직접 와 주길 원했어요.

english: The team next door holds its stand-up beside you every morning.
korean: 옆 팀이 매일 아침 내 옆에서 스탠드업을 해요.

english: How do you handle the noise?
A light that turns red when it’s loud
A visible cue to keep it down
A traffic light for talking? Okay, we'll try it.
The light stayed red. Our stand-up now feels like a whisper.
korean: 불이 계속 빨간색이었어요. 이제 스탠드업이 속삭이는 수준이에요.

english: Move stand-ups to a bar table
Fair enough. A bar table is better for us too.
korean: 그렇네요. 저희도 바 테이블이 더 나아요.

english: Two desks went. New starters next month have nowhere fixed to sit.
korean: 책상 2개가 빠졌어요. 다음 달 신입은 고정석이 없어요.

english: By eleven your head hurts and the analysis is half done.
korean: 11시쯤 머리가 아픈데 분석은 반밖에 못 했어요.

english: A whole day of data analysis ahead.
Where do you spend the day?
Your focus, everyone else's corridor calls.
All day? I hoped to grab it for a call.
korean: 하루 종일요? 저 통화하려고 쓰려 했는데.

english: Three people needed the pod for calls. They took them in the corridor.
korean: 세 명이 통화하려고 부스가 필요했는데, 결국 복도에서 받았어요.

english: Real quiet, but out of reach.
korean: 진짜 조용함, 대신 연락이 안 닿음.

english: Silence. Finally. Just me and the data.
We needed a quick answer and walked across the floor to find you.
korean: 급히 물어볼 게 있어서 사무실 반대편까지 찾으러 갔어요.

english: A bright desk by the window
Lucky you. That's the best seat on the floor.
Someone who wanted the window seat sat by the printer instead.
korean: 창가 자리를 원하던 사람은 대신 프린터 옆에 앉았어요.

english: Your tool certification module is due this week.
korean: 장비 인증 모듈 마감이 이번 주예요.

english: Where do you do the module?
Thursday at two is the next slot. Seat booked.
Thursday at two clashes with the customer review. You can't do both.
korean: 목요일 2시는 고객 리뷰랑 겹쳐요. 둘 다는 못 해요.

english: VR? I want a turn after you.
The meeting room became the VR bay. Today's review had nowhere to go.
korean: 회의실이 VR실이 됐어요. 오늘 리뷰는 갈 곳이 없었어요.

english: Easy to start, slow to finish.
Fit it in when you can
I'll squeeze it in between emails.
Four interruptions later, you're still on module two.
A yield issue across two teams
Big shared table between the teams
korean: 두 팀 사이의 큰 공용 테이블

english: Good. Everyone round the table, maps out, let's crack it.
korean: 좋아요. 다 같이 모여서 맵 펼치고 해결해봐요.

english: The table worked, but the desks around it couldn't hear their own calls.
korean: 테이블은 효과가 있었지만, 주변 자리는 자기 통화도 안 들렸어요.

english: Tool down at the fab. The line has stopped.
Wall of screens watching tools live
Live tool data on one wall
korean: 한 벽에 모인 실시간 장비 데이터

english: Good. Get the logs on the big screen now.
korean: 좋아요. 로그 바로 큰 화면에 띄워요.

english: We spotted the fault fast. But the morning meeting had no room.
korean: 고장은 빨리 찾았어요. 그런데 아침 회의할 방이 없었어요.

english: Guide the fab team by AR
Expert eyes at the fab instantly
Okay, our engineer has the headset on now.
korean: 네, 저희 엔지니어가 지금 헤드셋 썼어요.

english: The headset bay took the quiet corner. Focus work moved to the canteen.
korean: 헤드셋 공간이 조용한 코너를 차지했어요. 집중 업무는 구내식당으로 갔어요.

english: Thank you. Please hurry, the line is waiting.
You arrived at eight. The line was down a whole extra hour.
korean: 8시에 도착했어요. 라인이 한 시간 더 멈춰 있었어요.

english: Half the team is on video
Half the team is at the fabs. The meeting has to work on video.
korean: 팀 절반이 팹에 있어요. 회의를 화상으로 해야 해요.

english: Where does the hybrid meeting happen?
Small room with a video bar
The fab side can finally hear us properly.
korean: 드디어 팹 쪽에서 우리 말이 잘 들리네요.

english: Two desks went for the pod. The new hire sits at a spare corner.
korean: 부스 때문에 책상 2개가 빠졌어요. 신입 사원은 남는 구석에 앉아요.

english: The big room, one floor up
Ten minutes and a relaxed tone
Fine, but we start late with the walk up.
Nobody spoke up. It felt like presenting, not discussing.
korean: 아무도 말을 안 했어요. 토론이 아니라 발표 같았어요.

english: Could you keep it down a little?
Half the floor heard your meeting. Two people left to find quiet.
korean: 사무실 절반이 회의를 다 들었어요. 두 명은 조용한 곳을 찾아 떠났어요.

english: The install schedule changes every day. We need one view of it.
korean: 설치 일정이 매일 바뀌어요. 한눈에 볼 곳이 필요해요.

english: Lean board wall with sticky notes
One clear wall, one less sofa.
korean: 명확한 벽 하나, 소파 하나 감소.

english: A wall of sticky notes. Very lean, very us.
Half the notes were outdated by noon. Nobody updated the wall.
korean: 점심쯤 메모 절반이 옛날 거였어요. 아무도 벽을 업데이트 안 했어요.

english: Good. Roll it over for the 9 o'clock.
The screen sat unplugged in a corner. Nobody knew who owned it.
korean: 스크린이 코드 뽑힌 채 구석에 있었어요. 담당자가 누군지 아무도 몰라요.

english: Easy to share, easy to miss.
Another spreadsheet. Which tab is the real one?
Two teams worked from different versions. One install got double-booked.
korean: 두 팀이 서로 다른 버전으로 일했어요. 설치 하나가 중복 예약됐어요.

english: Got ten minutes? Quick question about the PM plan.
korean: 10분만 시간 돼요? PM 계획 관련해서 잠깐 질문이요.

english: Where do you talk it through?
Perfect. Ten minutes, standing, then back to work.
Two desks went. A visiting engineer worked from the canteen.
korean: 책상 2개가 빠졌어요. 방문 엔지니어는 구내식당에서 일했어요.

english: Is it free? Let me check the booking.
The room was booked. Ten minutes became a meeting tomorrow.
korean: 방이 예약돼 있었어요. 10분 얘기가 내일 회의가 됐어요.

english: Could you two take that somewhere else?
korean: 두 분, 다른 데서 얘기해 주실래요?

english: Your chat ran twenty minutes. The desk next to you lost focus.
korean: 대화가 20분이나 갔어요. 옆자리는 집중이 다 깨졌어요.

english: An open table to sit and talk
Nice. Let's grab the round table.
The table took a desk. Hot-desk mornings got a little tighter.
korean: 테이블이 책상 하나를 차지했어요. 공용 좌석 아침이 조금 더 빠듯해졌어요.

english: New process idea. We need to sketch it out.
korean: 새 공정 아이디어가 있어요. 그려봐야 해요.

english: Where do you sketch it out?
Great. Grab a marker, let's draw it out.
The pinboard came down. Safety notices now hang on the fridge.
korean: 게시판을 뗐어요. 안전 공지는 이제 냉장고에 붙어 있어요.

english: Cubes? Okay, let's make a circle.
Two desks went for cubes. They were moved and never put back.
korean: 큐브 때문에 책상 2개가 빠졌어요. 옮긴 큐브는 제자리로 안 돌아왔어요.

english: A private board to sketch on
Book one. Earliest slot is at four.
By four the energy was gone. The idea felt smaller.
The 6-seat room is booked all week by one person.
korean: 6인 회의실을 한 사람이 일주일 내내 예약했어요.

english: What do you do about bookings?
Rooms free up after 10 minutes empty
Finally. No more holding rooms for nobody.
korean: 드디어요. 아무도 안 쓰는 방 잡아두기는 끝이에요.

english: I was five minutes late from the fab. My room was gone.
We can split it with a wall this week.
korean: 이번 주에 벽으로 나눌 수 있어요.

english: The design review needed six seats. We squeezed into a four-room.
Peace with one person, not the team.
So we just keep waiting? Okay.
We held our meeting in the corridor again. It was empty all day.
korean: 또 복도에서 회의했어요. 그 방은 하루 종일 비어 있었어요.

english: Can you see what I see?
I’m at the tool. Can you see what I see?
korean: 장비 앞이에요. 제가 보는 게 보이세요?

english: How do you see the tool?
I see your arrow. Turning that valve now.
korean: 화살표 보여요. 그 밸브 지금 돌릴게요.

english: The headset bay took the quiet corner. Calls now happen at desks.
korean: 헤드셋 공간이 조용한 코너를 차지했어요. 통화는 이제 자리에서 해요.

english: Book a room and dial in
A proper screen to look at
Okay. I'll hold the phone steady until then.
korean: 네. 그때까지 폰 잘 들고 있을게요.

english: We waited thirty minutes for a room. The tool stayed down.
Thank you. I'll wait here with the tool.
You reached the fab at half five. Dinner is not happening.
korean: 5시 반에 팹에 도착했어요. 저녁은 물 건너갔어요.

english: Handover before you head to the fab.
A handover spot by the door
Good. I'll leave the logs here every morning.
korean: 좋아요. 매일 아침 여기 로그 두고 갈게요.

english: A customer arrived. There was nowhere to welcome them.
Can you see my screen? The connection's a bit slow.
korean: 제 화면 보여요? 연결이 좀 느리네요.

english: Your home wifi dropped twice. We missed the alarm history.
korean: 집 와이파이가 두 번 끊겼어요. 알람 이력을 놓쳤어요.

english: Close to the tool, far from the team.
Fine. Meet me at the tool bay.
You haven't been in the office all week. We miss your input.
korean: 일주일 내내 사무실에 안 왔네요. 의견이 아쉬워요.

english: This month: three days a week at the fab, two at the office.
Your desk, empty most of the week.
korean: 내 자리, 일주일 대부분 비어 있음.

english: Fine by me. I'll keep using the corner by the printer.
korean: 저는 괜찮아요. 프린터 옆 구석 계속 쓸게요.

english: Two new hires were seated by the printer. Your desk sat empty.
korean: 신입 두 명이 프린터 옆에 앉았어요. 당신 자리는 비어 있었고요.

english: A teammate uses it when you’re out
Shared desk, clash when plans change.
A desk that never sits idle
You still keep a home base
Great, I'll use it Monday to Wednesday. I'll keep it tidy.
Your fab visit moved to Thursday. Your desk was already taken.
korean: 팹 방문이 목요일로 바뀌었어요. 자리는 이미 누가 쓰고 있었어요.

english: Any desk, things safe in a locker
Your locker is number 14. Grab any free desk.
Your team spread across the floor. It took a while to find them.
korean: 팀이 사무실 곳곳에 흩어졌어요. 찾는 데 한참 걸렸어요.

english: A customer delegation of eight arrives at two.
Where do you host the delegation?
Sofas and check-in at the entry
Great first impression, four fewer desks.
A proper welcome at the door
What a nice welcome. Can we sit here before the meeting?
korean: 환영이 정말 좋네요. 회의 전에 여기 앉아 있어도 될까요?

english: The team that lost four desks spent the afternoon at the long table.
korean: 책상 4개를 잃은 팀은 오후 내내 긴 테이블에서 일했어요.

english: A cutaway tool on a plinth
Impressive tool, one less meeting room.
A real tool for guests to see
Guests see the tool up close
So that is what sits inside the chamber. Very impressive.
korean: 챔버 안이 저렇게 생겼군요. 정말 인상적이에요.

english: Our weekly review had no room. We met standing in the corridor.
korean: 주간 리뷰할 방이 없었어요. 복도에 서서 했어요.

english: No change, but far and formal.
A room big enough for all
Boardroom is booked. It's on the top floor, so start walking early.
korean: 대회의실 예약됐어요. 꼭대기 층이라 일찍 출발하세요.

english: The long walk and formal table made the talk feel stiff.
korean: 긴 이동과 격식 있는 테이블 때문에 대화가 딱딱했어요.

english: Live show, glare for the desks nearby.
I'll put the etch run on the big screen. They'll love it.
korean: 식각 공정을 큰 화면에 띄울게요. 좋아하실 거예요.

english: The wall screens shone on our desks all afternoon. Hard to focus.
korean: 벽 스크린이 오후 내내 우리 자리를 비췄어요. 집중이 안 됐어요.

english: Visitors keep wandering into the engineering zone.
How do you keep visitors out?
Gates go live Monday. Every guest needs an escort inside.
korean: 월요일부터 게이트 가동해요. 안에선 손님마다 동행이 필요해요.

english: I waited at the gate for my badge. Missed the start of standup.
korean: 게이트에서 출입증 기다리다가 스탠드업 시작을 놓쳤어요.

english: Calm floor, guests kept at a distance.
Comfortable here. But I hoped to meet the engineers at their desks.
korean: 여기 편하네요. 그런데 엔지니어들 자리에서 만나고 싶었어요.

english: The customer wanted to see the team. We stayed stuck at the front.
korean: 고객은 팀을 보고 싶어 했는데, 우린 앞쪽에만 묶여 있었어요.

english: Open floor, paperwork at the door
Peace of mind at your desk
Everyone signs at the desk. Then they're free to go in.
korean: 모두 데스크에서 서명해요. 그다음엔 자유롭게 들어가요.

english: A guest stopped by a desk and read a customer roadmap on screen.
korean: 손님 한 명이 자리 앞에 멈춰서 화면 속 고객 로드맵을 읽었어요.

english: Your visitors are here early. Lunch with them?
korean: 방문객이 일찍 왔어요. 같이 점심 할까요?

english: A long table for shared meals
Eating with the whole team? I like this. Very relaxed.
korean: 팀 전체랑 같이 먹어요? 좋네요. 아주 편해요.

english: Lunch chatter drifted over to our desks. My call was hard to hear.
korean: 점심 수다가 우리 자리까지 들렸어요. 통화가 잘 안 들렸어요.

english: A garden-like café on the floor
Is this inside the office? It feels like a garden.
Four people moved to make room for the café. They're still unpacking.
korean: 카페 자리 만드느라 네 명이 자리를 옮겼어요. 아직도 짐 푸는 중이에요.

english: Half your lunch to the queue
Hard to talk in the noise
Sure, the cafeteria is fine. Is the line always this long?
korean: 네, 구내식당 좋아요. 줄이 항상 이렇게 길어요?

english: We spent most of lunch in the queue. Little time to talk.
korean: 점심시간 대부분을 줄 서느라 썼어요. 얘기할 시간이 별로 없었어요.

english: Quiet booths to eat and talk
A booth is perfect. We can talk about the order here.
korean: 부스 딱 좋네요. 여기서 주문 얘기해요.

english: The booths were full all afternoon. People used them as meeting rooms.
korean: 부스는 오후 내내 꽉 찼어요. 다들 회의실처럼 썼어요.

english: Your lunch delivery is at the gate, five floors down.
korean: 점심 배달이 다섯 층 아래 정문에 도착했어요.

english: Warm food upstairs, full at peak.
Hot lunch steps from your desk
Locker 6. Still hot. Back at my desk in a minute.
korean: 6번 사물함. 아직 따뜻해요. 금방 자리로 갈게요.

english: All lockers were full at noon. My lunch waited downstairs anyway.
korean: 정오에 사물함이 꽉 찼어요. 결국 제 점심은 아래층에서 기다렸어요.

english: Your bag is on the pantry counter. Next to about twenty others.
korean: 봉지는 탕비실 카운터에 있어요. 스무 개쯤 되는 봉지 옆에요.

english: Someone took the wrong bag. The pantry smelled of food all afternoon.
korean: 누가 봉지를 잘못 가져갔어요. 오후 내내 탕비실에 음식 냄새가 났어요.

english: Okay, heading down. Hope the lift isn't full again.
korean: 알겠어요, 내려가요. 엘리베이터가 또 꽉 차진 않았으면.

english: You came back late. The 1 pm sync started without you.
The robot is great. Unless the whole floor wants coffee at three.
korean: 로봇 좋아요. 층 전체가 3시에 커피 찾지만 않으면요.

english: Everyone came at three. The queue and grinder noise reached our desks.
korean: 다들 3시에 몰렸어요. 줄이랑 그라인더 소리가 자리까지 왔어요.

english: A café bar on the floor
Finally, decent coffee. And somewhere to sit for five minutes.
korean: 드디어 괜찮은 커피네요. 5분 앉아 있을 곳도 생기고요.

english: The café crowd got loud. The team nearby moved to quiet rooms.
korean: 카페가 시끄러워졌어요. 근처 팀은 조용한 방으로 옮겼어요.

english: Drip coffee again. Well, it keeps me awake.
korean: 또 드립 커피네요. 뭐, 잠은 깨니까요.

english: The pot was empty again. People went out to the café instead.
korean: 포트가 또 비었어요. 다들 밖에 카페로 나갔어요.

english: The canteen is closed and your shift starts at six.
What do you eat before shift?
Food any hour, thin choice late.

korean: 매 근무 전 제대로 된 식사

english: Rice bowl, still warm. Ready by six.
korean: 덮밥, 아직 따뜻해요. 6시 전에 준비 완료.

english: By the night shift the lockers were almost empty. Same two meals left.
korean: 야간 근무 때쯤 사물함이 거의 비었어요. 같은 메뉴 두 개만 남았어요.

english: Instant noodles and a banana. It will do.
The pantry shelves are packed. There's no room left to make tea.
korean: 탕비실 선반이 꽉 찼어요. 차 탈 공간도 없어요.

english: A floor that stays the same
No food again. Coffee will have to do.
You were slow on the first tool check. Hunger caught up.
korean: 첫 장비 점검이 느렸어요. 배고픔이 티가 났네요.

english: Twelve hours in the fab. The report is still due.
How do you get through the report?
A rest, but only one recliner.
Twenty minutes with my feet up. Then the report.
Two people came in after their shift. One recliner, three tired engineers.
korean: 근무 끝나고 두 명이 더 왔어요. 리클라이너 하나에 지친 엔지니어 셋.

english: A hot shower first. I feel human again.
korean: 뜨거운 샤워부터. 이제 좀 사람 같네요.

english: The storage boxes moved into the corridor. Now they block the fire door.
korean: 창고 박스가 복도로 나왔어요. 지금 비상문을 막고 있어요.

english: Okay, go rest. But I need it first thing tomorrow.
korean: 알겠어요, 가서 쉬어요. 대신 내일 아침 일찍 줘야 해요.

english: The customer asked for the report tonight. It wasn't ready.
korean: 고객이 오늘 밤에 보고서를 요청했어요. 준비가 안 됐네요.

english: You have been sitting for four hours.
Moving at work, a hum nearby.
Slow walk, emails open. Not bad.
korean: 천천히 걸으면서 메일 확인. 나쁘지 않네요.

english: The treadmill hum carried across the row during my call.
korean: 통화 중에 러닝머신 소리가 줄 전체에 울렸어요.

english: Gym on the floor, one less room.
korean: 층 안의 헬스장, 회의실은 하나 줄고.

english: Five minutes on the bike? I'll join you.
No meeting room was free for the design review. We used the pantry.
korean: 설계 리뷰할 회의실이 없었어요. 탕비실에서 했어요.

english: Fresh air, if the weather allows.
One loop outside. Wait, is it raining?
korean: 밖에 한 바퀴. 잠깐, 비 와요?

english: Rain started halfway round. You came back wet and sat down again.
korean: 반쯤 돌았을 때 비가 왔어요. 젖은 채로 돌아와 다시 앉았어요.

english: Where do you go to be alone?
True quiet, one less meeting room.
Dim lights, door shut. Ten minutes is enough.
Our team sync lost its room. We crammed into a phone booth.
korean: 팀 싱크할 방이 없어졌어요. 폰부스에 우르르 끼어 들어갔어요.

english: Cosy corner, people still pass by.
A swing seat by the window
Swinging by the window. Better than I expected.
People stopped to chat by the swing. Not much quiet after all.
korean: 다들 그네 옆에서 멈춰 수다를 떨었어요. 결국 별로 조용하지 않았어요.

english: A spot that is always free
The stairwell again. At least nobody is here.
Someone took the stairs and stopped to talk. The break was over.
korean: 누가 계단으로 오다가 말을 걸었어요. 휴식 끝.

english: Quiet room for prayer or reflection
Calm space, one less meeting room.
A room for prayer or reflection
Calm for anyone who needs it
Thank you. I used to pray in my car.
We needed a room for a call. The reflection room sat empty.
korean: 통화할 방이 필요했는데, 명상실은 비어 있었어요.

english: A colleague is back from parental leave and needs a private room twice a day.
korean: 육아휴직에서 복귀한 동료가 하루 두 번 개인 공간이 필요해요.

english: A fridge and a sink. This makes coming back so much easier.
One fewer phone booth. I took my call in the corridor.
korean: 폰부스가 하나 줄었어요. 저는 복도에서 통화했어요.

english: A room when one is free
I'll check the booking app. Hope something's free at two.
korean: 예약 앱 확인해 볼게요. 2시에 빈 방이 있으면 좋겠네요.

english: Every small room was booked. I waited twenty minutes for one.
korean: 작은 방이 전부 예약돼 있었어요. 20분 기다렸어요.

english: More home time, less office time.
korean: 집에선 더 길게, 사무실에선 더 짧게.

english: Time at home with the baby
I'll leave at three then. Can we move the review earlier?
korean: 그럼 3시에 퇴근할게요. 리뷰를 앞당길 수 있을까요?

english: The afternoon review moved twice to fit. Two teams had to shuffle.
korean: 오후 리뷰를 맞추느라 두 번이나 옮겼어요. 두 팀이 일정을 바꿔야 했어요.

english: Last shuttle at 18:20. The meeting is running late.
Live timetable at a lobby lounge
Live shuttle times in the lobby
Board says four minutes. Time to wrap up and go.
Guests waited standing in the lobby. The lounge took their seats.
korean: 손님들이 로비에서 서서 기다렸어요. 라운지가 좌석을 차지했거든요.

english: Leave early when you need to
Go catch it. Let's move this meeting to the morning.
korean: 얼른 타러 가요. 이 회의는 아침으로 옮기죠.

english: Tomorrow starts with a 7:30 meeting. Not everyone is happy.
korean: 내일은 7:30 회의로 시작해요. 다들 좋아하진 않네요.

english: A parking space for someone else
I'll drive in from now on. No more running for the shuttle.
korean: 이제부터 차로 다닐래요. 셔틀 잡으러 뛰는 건 끝.

english: Stuck in traffic at the gate. Home later than the shuttle would be.
korean: 정문에서 차가 막혔어요. 셔틀보다 늦게 집에 도착했어요.

english: The car park is full by 8:15.
Bays for people driving to fabs
Great for me. I'm at the fab three days this week.
korean: 저한텐 딱이에요. 이번 주 사흘은 팹에 있거든요.

english: I circled for twenty minutes and parked on the street.
Bike racks and showers go into the basement store.
korean: 자전거 거치대와 샤워실은 지하 창고에 들어가요.

english: The basement store is gone. Spare parts now sit in the hallway.
korean: 지하 창고가 없어졌어요. 이제 예비 부품이 복도에 있어요.

english: More runs, still on a timetable.
Two more runs added. First one leaves at 7:10.
korean: 두 편 추가했어요. 첫 차는 7:10 출발이에요.

english: The extra run still didn't stop near me. I drove again.
korean: 추가 편도 우리 집 근처엔 안 서요. 또 차 끌고 왔어요.

english: You arrive. Where do you head first?
A home zone with your team
Morning. Your usual corner's free, same as always.
korean: 좋은 아침이에요. 늘 앉던 코너 비어 있어요.

english: The cross-team engineer you needed sat two zones away all morning.
korean: 필요했던 타 팀 엔지니어가 오전 내내 두 구역 떨어져 있었어요.

english: Find a free spot on a map
Easy to find, hard to stay close.
See free spots at a glance
Okay, a free spot by the lab door. Good enough.
korean: 좋아요, 랩 문 옆 빈자리. 이 정도면 됐어요.

english: Your team landed in four different corners. Nobody overheard anything useful.
korean: 팀원들이 네 군데 코너에 흩어졌어요. 쓸 만한 얘기는 아무도 못 들었어요.

english: No effort, no place of your own.
This one's open. I'll just sit down here.
Your new neighbour has calls all morning. You moved twice already.
korean: 새 옆자리 사람이 오전 내내 통화해요. 벌써 두 번 옮겼어요.

english: Traffic jam to Hwaseong. A satellite hub is 15 minutes away.
korean: 화성 가는 길이 꽉 막혔어요. 거점 오피스는 15분 거리예요.

english: Where do you work this morning?
Short commute, far from the action.
Hub desk booked. Coffee in fifteen minutes instead of ninety.
korean: 거점 자리 예약 완료. 90분 대신 15분 만에 커피.

english: The tool alarm was solved at the bench. You only heard after.
korean: 장비 알람은 벤치에서 해결됐어요. 나중에야 소식을 들었죠.

english: Calmer drive, a day cut short.
Skip the worst of the jam
Fine, just dial in to stand-up from the car.
Stand-up decided the week's priorities. You joined halfway, on mute.
korean: 스탠드업에서 이번 주 우선순위가 정해졌어요. 중간에 음소거로 들어왔죠.

english: Saved the drive, lost the day on site.
No problem. I'll message you if the tool acts up.
korean: 괜찮아요. 장비가 말썽 부리면 메시지 드릴게요.

english: The tool acted up. They had to wait until you were back tomorrow.
korean: 장비가 말썽을 부렸어요. 내일 돌아올 때까지 기다려야 했어요.

english: A new engineer starts on Monday.
Where does the new engineer sit?
Welcome desk with a starter kit
Warm welcome, a desk often empty.
A desk sits idle between hires
Lovely. I'll lay out the laptop and badge on Friday.
The welcome desk sits empty most weeks. Someone asked to use it.
korean: 환영 데스크가 대부분 비어 있어요. 누가 써도 되냐고 물어봤어요.

english: Elbow room at the mentor's desk
Sure, I'll pull up a second chair next to mine.
korean: 그럼요, 제 옆에 의자 하나 더 갖다 놓을게요.

english: Two people at one desk all week. The mentor's report slipped.
korean: 일주일 내내 책상 하나에 두 명. 멘토 보고서가 밀렸어요.

english: Easy for you, lonely for them.
Okay. I'll tell them to find an open desk.
They spent the first hour looking for a seat and a charger.
korean: 첫 한 시간을 자리랑 충전기 찾느라 보냈어요.

english: Can you walk me through that fault?
korean: 그 고장 건 좀 차근차근 설명해 주실래요?

english: Where do you explain the fault?
Two armchairs and a side table
Easy to talk, nothing to touch.
Thanks. Easier to ask silly questions here.
korean: 감사해요. 여기선 엉뚱한 질문도 하기 편하네요.

english: They understood the theory but still couldn't spot the fault on the tool.
korean: 이론은 이해했는데 장비에서 고장은 여전히 못 찾았어요.

english: A bench to learn on parts
Oh, so that's what the worn seal looks like.
Your lesson ran long. The bench test they'd queued had to wait.
korean: 수업이 길어졌어요. 잡아둔 벤치 테스트가 밀렸어요.

english: Could you two keep it down a little? I'm on a call.
korean: 두 분 조금만 조용히 해 주실래요? 통화 중이에요.

english: Your neighbour moved away mid-call. The lesson was cut short.
korean: 옆자리 사람이 통화 중에 자리를 옮겼어요. 수업은 중간에 끝났어요.

english: Next year we grow by 30%. Same floor.
The whole team on one floor
Good. One floor, one team. Make the booking work.
korean: 좋아요. 한 층, 한 팀. 예약 시스템이 잘 돌아가게 해 주세요.

english: On Tuesdays, five engineers had no desk and worked from the lounge.
korean: 화요일엔 엔지니어 다섯 명이 책상이 없어 라운지에서 일했어요.

english: Plenty of room, team in two places.
Fine. I'll ask Facilities to find a floor nearby.
korean: 좋아요. 시설팀에 근처 층을 찾아 달라고 할게요.

english: Half the team is across the street. Quick questions now need a meeting.
korean: 팀 절반이 길 건너에 있어요. 간단한 질문도 이제 회의가 필요해요.
모니터 두 대 놓을 공간 없음

english: Smaller? Where do my second screen and drawings go?
korean: 더 작게요? 제 보조 모니터랑 도면은 어디 둬요?

english: Everyone squeezed in. Drawings now pile on the floor beside desks.
korean: 다들 끼어 앉았어요. 이제 도면이 책상 옆 바닥에 쌓여 있어요.

english: Should we all come in on the same day?
When does the team come in?
One day with the whole team
Great. Tuesdays it is. Block your calendars.
korean: 좋아요. 화요일로 하죠. 캘린더 막아 두세요.

english: Tuesday came. Every meeting room was taken by nine.
Nice. I'll come whenever the tools need me.
Planning needed four people. They were never in on the same day.
korean: 기획에 네 명이 필요했는데, 같은 날 나온 적이 없었어요.

english: Calm floor, half the team away.
The whole team in one room
Okay. Group A Monday-Wednesday, group B Tuesday-Thursday.
The fix needed someone from group B. They were home today.
korean: 수리에 B그룹 사람이 필요했는데, 오늘 재택이었어요.

english: How do you get a desk?

korean: 확실함, 그리고 할 일 하나 더.

english: A desk you can count on
Booked. Window seat, near the team. Done for tonight.
korean: 예약 완료. 창가, 팀 근처. 오늘 밤은 끝.

english: You forgot to cancel last week. Your booked desk sat empty all day.
korean: 지난주에 취소를 깜빡했죠. 예약한 자리가 하루 종일 비어 있었어요.
할 일은 없지만, 자리도 보장 없음.

english: I'll just turn up and see what's free.
They're coming early tomorrow to grab the good desks. You won't.
korean: 다들 좋은 자리 잡으려고 내일 일찍 온대요. 나는 못 가요.

english: Together, but only on set days.
A team zone, booked for you
I'll block our zone for Tuesday and Thursday.
korean: 화요일, 목요일에 우리 구역 잡아 둘게요.

english: You need to come in Wednesday. The team zone isn't yours that day.
korean: 수요일에 출근해야 하는데, 그날은 팀 구역이 우리 게 아니에요.

english: The air conditioning is freezing by the window.
Your own climate, a less open floor.
Fixes it for the whole area
We'll zone the window side. You'll get a dial.
korean: 창가 쪽을 구역으로 나눌게요. 조절기도 드려요.

english: Your neighbour turned the dial cold again. Now there's a thermostat war.
korean: 옆자리가 또 온도를 낮췄어요. 이제 온도 전쟁이에요.

english: Sure, swap with me. I like it cold anyway.
korean: 그래요, 저랑 바꿔요. 전 추운 게 좋아요.

english: Warm now, but no daylight. The afternoon dragged on.
korean: 따뜻해졌지만 햇빛이 없어요. 오후가 너무 길었어요.

english: Kept the view, kept the chill.
Here, take my spare. Everyone by the window has one.
korean: 여기, 제 여분 써요. 창가 사람은 다 하나씩 있어요.

english: The blanket helped a little. Your hands were still too cold to type.
korean: 담요가 조금 도움은 됐어요. 그래도 손이 시려서 타이핑이 안 돼요.

english: Your seat is far from the windows.
We'll install tuning lights across the inner rows.
korean: 안쪽 줄 전체에 조절형 조명을 달게요.

english: The lights turned warm at four. It still felt like a basement.
Lounges by the glass, desks inside
Light for all, desks for none.
So my window desk becomes a lounge? Hmm, okay.
korean: 그럼 제 창가 자리가 라운지가 된다고요? 음, 알겠어요.

english: Lunch by the glass is lovely. Long focus hours now happen in the inner rows.
korean: 창가 점심은 좋아요. 긴 집중 업무는 이제 안쪽 줄에서 해요.

english: Simple rule, juniors in the dark.
So I'll be inside for a few more years, then.
korean: 그럼 전 몇 년 더 안쪽이네요.

english: A junior engineer asked why the light depends on job title.
korean: 주니어 엔지니어가 왜 직급에 따라 햇빛이 다르냐고 물었어요.

english: There is room for one green upgrade on the floor.
korean: 사무실에 그린 업그레이드 하나 할 자리가 있어요.

english: Which green upgrade gets the space?

korean: 보기만 할 뿐, 쓸 건 없음

english: Nice. Shame about the old fab photos, though.
korean: 좋네요. 옛날 팹 사진은 좀 아쉽지만요.

english: The plants look great. People ask where the team history photos went.
korean: 식물은 멋져요. 팀 역사 사진은 어디 갔냐고들 물어요.
재밌는 수확, 할 일 하나 더.

english: Basil at work? I'm in. Who's watering it though?
korean: 사무실에 바질이요? 찬성. 근데 물은 누가 줘요?

english: Nobody signed up to tend it. The lettuce is turning brown.
korean: 관리하겠다는 사람이 없었어요. 상추가 누렇게 변하고 있어요.

english: We'll line the terrace. Good for coffee breaks.
korean: 테라스에 쭉 놓을게요. 커피 타임에 좋아요.

english: It rained all week. Nobody saw the plants, and the floor stayed grey.
korean: 일주일 내내 비가 왔어요. 식물 본 사람도 없고, 사무실은 회색 그대로예요.

english: The bin is overflowing with paper cups.
What do you do about cups?
We can fit taps and sorted bins where the counter is.
korean: 카운터 자리에 급수대랑 분리수거함을 넣을 수 있어요.

english: The hub is busy, but the counter where people prepped lunch is gone.
korean: 리필 존은 붐비지만, 점심 준비하던 카운터가 없어졌어요.

english: Fine, but I left my mug at home today.
korean: 좋아요. 근데 오늘 머그컵을 집에 두고 왔어요.

english: Half the team forgot mugs. A customer visit had nothing to drink from.
korean: 팀 절반이 컵을 깜빡했어요. 고객 방문 때 마실 컵이 없었어요.

english: It's just cups. Someone will empty it.
The bin spilled over again and cups rolled onto the pantry floor.
korean: 쓰레기통이 또 넘쳐서 컵이 탕비실 바닥으로 굴러갔어요.

english: Should team leads keep their own offices?
korean: 팀장들이 개인 사무실을 계속 써야 할까요?

english: Alright, I'll sit with you all. Expect more questions from me.
korean: 좋아요, 여러분이랑 앉을게요. 질문 많이 할 거예요.

english: A hard one-to-one had nowhere private to go. They hunted for a room.
korean: 어려운 1:1 면담을 할 조용한 곳이 없어서 방을 찾아 헤맸어요.

english: Good. I need a door for performance talks.
Four people lost desks, and the team waits outside the glass to ask.
korean: 네 명이 자리를 잃었고, 팀원들은 유리문 밖에서 질문하려고 기다려요.

english: Shared rooms, no lead's own space.
I can work with that, as long as a room is free.
Every room was booked when a sensitive call came in. It waited.
korean: 민감한 전화가 왔을 때 방이 다 차 있어서 미뤄야 했어요.

english: The tool qualified two weeks early. Let’s celebrate.
Wins and photos on a wall
A lasting win, a lost pinboard.
Quiet, not much of a party
Put the qual photo up top. We earned that spot.
korean: 퀄 사진은 맨 위에 걸어요. 그 자리 받을 만해요.

english: The wall looks great, but the old notices have nowhere to go now.
korean: 벽은 멋진데, 기존 공지문 붙일 곳이 없어졌어요.

english: A place for the whole floor
Everyone on the steps. I'll say a few words.
korean: 다들 계단에 앉아요. 제가 몇 마디 할게요.

english: The stair is great for the big moment, but desks moved to fit it.
korean: 큰 행사엔 계단이 좋지만, 그 자리 때문에 책상을 옮겼어요.

english: Dinner out? I'm in. Somebody book a big table.
korean: 회식이요? 좋아요. 누가 큰 테이블 예약해 줘요.

english: Two engineers with early fab shifts had to leave before the food came.
korean: 팹 새벽 근무가 있는 엔지니어 둘은 음식 나오기 전에 떠났어요.

english: Fun corner, one less quiet spot.
korean: 재밌는 코너, 조용한 곳은 하나 줄고.

english: Board games and snacks? I'll bring the strategy one.
korean: 보드게임에 간식이요? 전략 게임은 제가 가져올게요.

english: Someone needed the quiet corner for a late call. It was full of games.
korean: 늦은 통화로 조용한 구석이 필요했는데, 게임으로 꽉 차 있었어요.

english: Table tennis! Winner stays on. I'm first.
korean: 탁구! 이긴 사람이 계속 해요. 제가 먼저요.

english: The pinging carried across the floor. Late workers couldn't hear their calls.
korean: 탁구 소리가 사무실 전체에 울렸어요. 야근자들은 통화를 못 들었어요.

english: A night away from the office
Let's go out. I know a good place nearby.
It was fun, but half the team headed home early for the commute.
korean: 재밌었지만, 팀 절반은 통근 때문에 일찍 집에 갔어요.

english: Customer drawings were left on the printer.
Prints still sit on the tray
Good. Anything confidential goes in the locked bin.
korean: 좋아요. 기밀 문서는 전부 잠금함에 넣어 주세요.

english: Bins are working, but another drawing still sat on the printer tray.
korean: 문서함은 잘 쓰이는데, 또 다른 도면이 프린터 트레이에 남아 있었어요.

english: Print only at the hub with a badge

korean: 사원증 찍기 전엔 출력 안 됨

english: Slower when you're in a rush
So I walk to the hub every time? Okay, fair.
korean: 매번 출력 존까지 가라고요? 뭐, 맞는 말이에요.

english: A rushed engineer walked to the hub three times before the customer call.
korean: 급한 엔지니어가 고객 통화 전에 출력 존을 세 번이나 오갔어요.

english: No printing at all? I review drawings on paper.
korean: 출력을 아예 안 해요? 전 도면을 종이로 검토하는데요.

english: Reviewing a big drawing on a laptop took twice as long.
korean: 큰 도면을 노트북으로 검토하니 두 배나 걸렸어요.

english: Your laptop broke at the fab.
How do you get working again?
Fixed or swapped on the spot
Bring it over. We'll have you sorted this morning.
The IT bar was busy, and two engineers lost their desks for it.
korean: IT 바는 붐볐고, 그것 때문에 엔지니어 둘이 자리를 잃었어요.

english: Pick up a spare from a locker
Tap your badge at the locker. A spare is waiting.
korean: 사물함에 사원증을 찍으세요. 예비 노트북이 있어요.

english: The spare worked, but your tools and files took an hour to set up.
korean: 예비 노트북은 됐는데, 툴이랑 파일 세팅에 한 시간 걸렸어요.

english: We'll ship it today. Expect it back in a few days.
korean: 오늘 보낼게요. 며칠 뒤에 돌아올 거예요.

english: The customer report is due, and you're borrowing a teammate's screen.
korean: 고객 보고서 마감인데, 팀원 화면을 빌려 쓰고 있네요.

english: I’m here for a 9 o’clock with the CMP team. Which way?
How do visitors find their way?
Signs with live maps at each junction
Maps need keeping up to date
Oh, a map. CMP team is just past the corner.
korean: 아, 지도가 있네요. CMP팀은 모퉁이 바로 너머네요.

english: A cart caught a totem at the junction. It's a tight squeeze now.
korean: 카트가 교차로 사인에 걸렸어요. 이제 지나가기 빡빡해요.

english: One clear walkway through the floor
A clear path through the floor
Just follow the main walkway? Easy enough.
The new walkway runs past our desks. People stroll by all day.
korean: 새 통로가 우리 자리 옆을 지나요. 하루 종일 사람들이 오가요.

english: Touch screen to find people and rooms
Takes a spot by the lift
Let me search CMP. There it is, room three.
korean: CMP 검색해 볼게요. 여기 있네요, 3번 회의실.

english: A queue formed at the kiosk, blocking the lift doors at nine.
korean: 9시에 키오스크 앞에 줄이 생겨서 엘리베이터 문을 막았어요.

english: A teammate feels faint after a double shift. Where can they lie down?
korean: 연속 근무 후 팀원이 어지러워해요. 어디 누울 데 있을까요?
제대로 된 돌봄, 폰부스는 하나 줄고.

english: Thanks. A proper bed and a closed door helps.
korean: 고마워요. 제대로 된 침대에 문까지 닫히니 좋네요.

english: They rested well, but two calls queued for the one booth left.
korean: 푹 쉬었지만, 하나 남은 폰부스에 통화 두 건이 줄을 섰어요.

english: Room to rest, one less meeting room.
korean: 쉴 방은 생기고, 회의실은 하나 줄고.

english: Harder to find a meeting room
A quiet room. I just need twenty minutes.
The 4pm review had no room. We squeezed into the pantry.
korean: 4시 리뷰할 방이 없어서 탕비실에 끼어 앉았어요.

english: A recliner in a quiet corner
A rest spot near the desks
A recliner works. Just let me close my eyes.
korean: 리클라이너면 돼요. 잠깐 눈 좀 붙일게요.

english: People kept walking past. They didn't feel comfortable resting there.
korean: 사람들이 계속 지나다녀서 편하게 쉬지 못했어요.
